title: 5 Euro Cents - Beatrix

obverse.description: Profile of Queen Beatrix encircled by twelve stars of Europe.

reverse.description: A globe, next to the face value, shows Europe in relation to Africa and Asia.

comments:
This coin was engraved by the Utrecht mint by several engravers in the following periods:

  • 1999: bow bandaged and cocked; Chris Van Dranen (titular)
  • 2000: banded and cocked bow and star; Erik Jan van Schouwenburg (interim)
  • 2001: cluster; Robert Bruens (incumbent)
  • 2002: cluster and star; Maarten Brouwer (interim)
  • 2003 - 2013: sails; Maarten Brouwer (incumbent)
